name: nis2-readiness
description: Get an EU company ready for NIS2 (Directive 2022/2555) and the German NIS2UmsuCG. Four deterministic stdlib scripts: a scope classifier that sorts entities into essential, important or out by sector and size and names the authority and registration duty; an Article 23 clock for the 24h early warning, 72h notification and one-month final report, with the Implementing Regulation 2024/2690 significance thresholds; an Article 21 gap check of 30 measures; and a router that lays NIS2, DORA, CRA and GDPR reporting clocks side by side for one event. Ships cs-nis2-officer agent, /cs-nis2-readiness, /cs-nis2-report and /cs-eu-cyber-scope commands, 3 cited references and an incident runbook.
